Update the 'Running locally' section in the README to document setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket when using MinIO, preventing AWS lookup errors.
args.title: Document MinIO setup steps in README

args.body:
label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

README.md mentions MinIO as the quickest option for local setup under 'Running locally', but omits mentioning S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation, leading to lookup errors against AWS. Update README.md under 'Running locally' to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket when using MinIO.
